memo_scope: One owned complete NO_CONNECTED_EDGE whole-state snapshot per run, shared across the three observers only. No helper receipt or work report reused. Positive capture always freshly computed.
copy_allowance: same per-operation finite allowance; unsupported or unfinished copy does not install an entry
equality: Exact builtin type-sensitive whole tree. dict exactstr keys with same complete key set, list/tuple distinct, bool/int distinct, all state fields included. Unsupported or inconclusive comparison falls through to unchanged full helper. Native/authority exceptions propagate.
entry_order: lookup counters and owned completed-negative comparison
on miss unchanged full helper; only complete NO_CONNECTED_EDGE may be copied into one owned entry
on CONNECTED always unchanged full report/copy/capture/stop/trace join
Source_guard_scope: Same helper module/function/code/default configuration and pinned Root native tick for memo lifetime; Root whole CodeSeal/prepost boundary unchanged. No arbitrary nth-tick callback equivalence.
